findings.source_delta: Diff against the backed-up pre-fix Io4Codec.cpp shows only the three explanatory comments and the additional `now - last_command_us < 0x80000000u` guard in the timeout condition. App.cpp and UsbBackend.cpp match the backup SHA values; no other application source changes are part of this candidate.
findings.arithmetic: A callback timestamp newer than cached now by a small amount appears as a modular difference near UINT32_MAX and is rejected by the half-range guard. Normal elapsed times below half range, including wraparound, remain eligible for timeout. Configured maximum is 255 * 100000us = 25.5s, far below the half-range horizon of about 35.8 minutes; the reported 2s service/watchdog cadence is also much shorter.
findings.regressions: Before-fix simulation passed the 11 prior groups and failed all three newly added tests at their expected future-time assertions. After-fix focused simulation passes 14/14; expanded simulation passes 25/25, including the original 22 IO4 backend/protocol/save/reboot groups.
findings.artifact_boundary: The simulation runner compiled ARM test/module objects and executed them under Unicorn. It did not produce a firmware UF2 or test a physical device. Previous firmware/UF2/validation artifacts remain historical; no board image changed, and no result here establishes hardware fix behavior. The backed-up source hashes preserve the pre-fix version.

recommendation: Candidate source logic is suitable for a separately reviewed real firmware build after physical return to NORMAL and the independent snapshot gates. Keep the candidate build and any later flash/reboot evidence as separate stages; do not mark the physical issue fixed until the newly built firmware is explicitly flashed and the board diagnostic is repeated.
